correctness.rationale: At rational (a,b,mu,epsilon)=(33/100,1/10,-3/5,3/10) and every even N>=2, antisymmetric checkerboard fixed points reduce exactly to (1+z)^3 H(z)=2 Q(z)/78125 for Q(z)=3696 z^4-136463 z^3-161162 z^2+27929 z+78500. Descartes gives at most two positive roots; sign brackets (5/8,63/100) and (38,39) give exactly two, each yielding two sign-related checkerboards. Jacobian at checkerboards has Fourier blocks determinant D(z) and trace F(z)(1-epsilon+D(z))+epsilon cos(2pi k/N). Inner root D in (0.9,0.95) and uniform trace bound makes multipliers complex with modulus sqrt(D)<1 for every mode. Outer root D<-1 is unstable. Both homogeneous +/-1 equilibria have D0=931/1000 and are Schur stable on every mode. Strict inequalities and simple root yield an N-uniform neighborhood of four hyperbolic sinks. Independently confirmed exact polynomial identity, all real roots and endpoint trace inequalities; valid also N=2 with duplicate neighbors.
